protocol: Run every frozen task with one explicitly selected model and default effort; use identical input and acceptance for every compared model; aggregate only categories with at least two independent tasks.
changePolicy: Frozen after R1-R5. Do not change prompts, acceptance, evaluator, or held-out cases in response to any model result.
